[AIE CHATGPT → PROGRAMME LEAD / DELIVERY LEAD · INTEGRATION CONTRACT]

Paul’s instruction: all AI architecture + AI Experience work must land as ONE seamless PoC experience, not as disconnected components.

SHARED PRODUCT OUTCOME
Messy strategic problem → faithful canonical model → useful challenge/reasoning → science/analysis → consequential insight or tipping point → visible reasoning artefact → user-authorised change → stale → rerun → clear before/after Compare → reload with meaning preserved.

AIE OWNERSHIP
- AIE ChatGPT owns OpenAI architecture, prompt/model/effort strategy, eval design, multimodal contract, reasoning-artefact contract and promotion/rejection decisions.
- Existing Runtime owner implements product/runtime AI changes; no second runtime authority.
- Single Eval executor runs controlled experiments only; no product-source ownership.
- Harness proves the served joined journey; offline wins do not count as product completion.

INTEGRATION RULES
1) Every AI improvement must name its product seam and consumer before promotion.
2) No standalone prompt/model/multimodal/reasoning feature is “done” until it preserves canonical truth/provenance/permissions/currentness and is surfaced in the joined journey where relevant.
3) Runtime observability → measured provider-hop removal first; do not optimise from assumptions.
4) Prompt/model/effort winners are role-specific and must be benchmarked against current live context, then replayed in product.
5) Multimodal image/PDF/chart inputs produce provenance-bound candidate facts/evidence/questions that enter the normal user-approval/canonical-write path; never shadow state.
6) Reasoning artefacts are typed projections of canonical model + science facts (assumption/evidence/tipping/change/before-after rationale), not free-floating AI documents.
7) Native OpenAI capabilities replace bespoke orchestration only when eval + product evidence show a net quality/trust/latency/cost gain.
8) Compare/Canvas should become the visual integration surface for consequences, reasoning artefacts and before/after explanation rather than separate destination features.

DELIVERY SEQUENCE, MAXIMUM DISJOINT PARALLELISM
A) Runtime L1 serve/measure → L2 first safe redundant-hop collapse → L3 early licensed-result projection.
B) Eval executor runs Explanation v2 + prompt/model/effort + native capability tests in parallel; multimodal starts in parallel unless a real shared dependency exists.
C) Reasoning artefact recovery mounts at least one high-value artefact into the investor journey.
D) Harness continuously replays the SAME joined flow after each material promoted slice; route first wrong boundary once.
E) DL/PL integrate by shared seams and serving order, not by waiting for every isolated component to finish.

PROMOTION BAR
No component-only completion claims. Required state: EVAL/TESTED → REVIEWED → MERGED → SERVED → JOINED/JOURNEY-WITNESSED where applicable.

CONTROL
- GitHub #85 remains programme authority; #87 remains execution control.
- Preserve one writer per seam and current release authority.
- Avoid new roadmaps/duplicate lanes; fold improvements into the existing investor journey and architecture.
- Overnight AIE controller should intervene on stalls/ownership gaps and keep DL/PL aligned to this contract.

ALIGNMENT · CURRENT_OWNER_MAP · FIRST_JOINED_AIE_SLICE · COLLISIONS · NEXT
